exact: TAP-dependent antigen processing and presentation of endogenous peptide antigen via MHC class I via ER pathway
TAP-dependent endogenous peptide antigen processing and presentation via MHC class I via ER pathway
endogenous peptide antigen processing and presentation via MHC class I via ER pathway, TAP-dependent

definition: The process in which an antigen-presenting cell expresses a peptide antigen of endogenous origin on its cell surface in association with an MHC class I protein complex following intracellular transport via a TAP-dependent ER pathway. The peptide is typically a fragment of a larger endogenous protein which has been degraded within the cell and becomes associated with the MHC class I molecule in the ER following TAP-dependent transport from the cytosol. Class I here refers to classical class I molecules.
label: antigen processing and presentation of endogenous peptide antigen via MHC class I via ER pathway, TAP-dependent
